C0404.title: Cookie Theft to Business Email Compromise: Attackers Use AiTM Phishing Sites as Entry Point
C0404.summary: Microsoft security researchers discovered that attackers used adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) phishing sites to steal user session cookies. Even when the targeted organization had multi-factor authentication (MFA) enabled, attackers could use the stolen cookies containing MFA claims to bypass authentication and directly access user accounts.
